rationale: Pre-registered rule (DESIGN 6.4): raw always; from the fixed list (lda32, lda16, lda32+sh64, lda32+q1, anchor32, center+noise0.5, linfn) only protections inside the dev utility budget (EER <= 1.15 x raw, minDCF <= raw + 0.02, full precision); plus up to 3 more in-budget protections with the lowest train-selected-attacker top-1 (exactly three candidates per embedder, all tied at 1.0, so no tie-break was needed); keyrot excluded because with the key it equals raw. redimnet2-b2 (primary): raw, linfn, center+q2, center+q4, center+noise0.25 (center+noise0.5 misses at +18.5 % EER). ecapa-vox: raw, center+noise0.5, linfn, center+q2, center+q4, center+noise0.25. titanet-s: raw, center+q2. Plan 5.80 GPU-hours < 8. Decided from utility and inversion numbers only; no cloning number exists.
